choice.basis: The chart's legend explicitly maps color to prevalence: pale yellow = 100 (Low), dark burgundy = 0 (High). New York (NY) is colored dark burgundy, matching the 'High' end of the scale. North Carolina (NC) is pale yellow, matching the 'Low' end. Delaware (DE) is light orange, indicating medium prevalence. Therefore, New York has the highest prevalence among the three options.
